action.command:
echo "=== Filament admin login POST test ==="; cd /tmp; JAR=/tmp/cj.txt; rm -f $JAR; # get csrf
CSRF=$(curl -s -c $JAR -m 20 http://localhost:3001/admin/login | grep -oE 'name="csrf-token" content="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*content="//;s/"//'); echo "csrf=${CSRF:0:20}..."; curl -s -b $JAR -c $JAR -m 20 -o /tmp/login_resp.html -w "login POST HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3001/admin/login -d "_token=$CSRF&email=hello@vereinfacht.digital&password=password"; echo "--- contains errors? ---"; grep -oiE '(invalid|credentials|error)[^<]{0,60}' /tmp/login_resp.html | head -5; echo "--- cookie set? ---"; grep -iE 'session|remember' $JAR | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "echo \"=== Filament admin login POST test ===\"; cd /tmp; JAR=/tmp/cj.txt; rm -f $JAR; # get csrf\nCSRF=$(curl -s -c $JAR -m 20 http://localhost:3001/admin/login | grep -oE 'name=\"csrf-token\" content=\"[^\"]*\"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*content=\"//;s/\"//'); echo \"csrf=${CSRF:0:20}...\"; curl -s -b $JAR -c $JAR -m 20 -o /tmp/login_resp.html -w \"login POST HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\\n\" -X POST http://localhost:3001/admin/login -d \"_token=$CSRF&email=hello@vereinfacht.digital&password=password\"; echo \"--- contains errors? ---\"; grep -oiE '(invalid|credentials|error)[^<]{0,60}' /tmp/login_resp.html | head -5; echo \"--- cookie set? ---\"; grep -iE 'session|remember' $JAR | head", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Test Filament admin login flow"}
